jobs.title: Night Shift Alarm Monitoring Specialist
jobs.description:
ECAMSECURE, a GardaWorld company, is seeking an Overnight Alarm Monitor in Dallas, TX. You will monitor live and recorded footage, assess risks, and take action following client protocols while maintaining confidentiality in a fast-paced security operation.

The role requires night, weekend, and holiday availability, proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Maps, and the ability to multitask across programs. Competitive pay and comprehensive benefits are offered.

jobs.title: Security Driver & Patrol Incident Response (Night Shift)
jobs.description:
Allied Universal is hiring a Security Officer Driver Patrol Incident Response in Euless, TX. You will perform driving unarmed patrols, respond to incidents, and ensure a safe environment while delivering excellent customer service. A valid driver’s license and a commitment to teamwork are required.

Typical schedule includes night shifts with rotating weekends. Join a leading security and facility services company known for a caring culture and opportunities for growth.

jobs.title: Overnight Hotel Security Officer — Guest Safety
jobs.description:
DoubleTree by Hilton DFW North in Irving, TX is seeking an Overnight Security professional to protect guests and hotel property. Join a hotel team that values safety, courtesy, and a calm demeanor during emergencies.

You will perform foot patrols, monitor alarms, respond to incidents, assist guests, and uphold hotel policies. The role requires English communication, physical stamina, and the ability to work on-site shifts in a fast-paced hospitality environment.

jobs.title: Night Shift Surveillance Officer: Detail-Driven Pro
jobs.description:
GardaWorld Security Services is recruiting a Surveillance Security Officer to monitor security systems and respond to incidents in night shifts. The role requires attention to detail, the ability to document events clearly, and exceptional observation skills.

You will patrol, control access, verify visitor identities, and work with law enforcement when needed. Must be 21+, with a valid driver’s license and US work authorization.

jobs.title: Night-Shift Hotel Security & Guest Experience
jobs.description:
Peachtree Group is seeking an overnight Security professional for the AC Hotel/Moxy in Dallas. You will patrol interior and exterior areas, respond to emergencies, and investigate incidents to protect guests, associates, visitors, and property while maintaining a welcoming environment.

In this role you’ll collaborate with hotel leadership to promote safety, write clear incident reports, and provide visible, courteous service to guests.
